changelog: Choose the intro clip from a dropdown; no default clip path. Intros for series episodes (every episode, first of each season or first of the series). Search helpers for the id lists.
description: Plays an intro clip of your choice before movies and/or series episodes using Jellyfin's cinema-mode intro mechanism, and hides the library that holds the clip from every user's home screen.
name: Movie Intro
overview: Intro before movies and series episodes (cinema mode)
